$comment: Far trees as multi-angle impostors (docs/proposals/TREE_IMPOSTORS.md, WORK_QUEUE item 31; owner, 2026-11-12: billboards from a few angles, from above too, "like old Mario kart did"). What the bake (dwell-worldgen `impostor`) makes of a species tree grown by `species::grow(species, seed, stage)`: `views` the view layout (`ring`: `azimuths` evenly spaced around the tree, at each of `elevationsDeg` above the horizon, plus one straight down when `top`), `viewPx` a view's square side in texels per renderer tier (desktop, phone, cpu), `stages` the growth stages baked (clamped to a species' last stage; a tree between them takes the nearest, scaled to its height), `variants` the seeds baked per species and stage (a tree takes variant hash(seed) mod variants), `albedo` the palette colour (shared/textures/palette.json, `ramp.stop` or a ramp's base) a leaf cell and a log are painted (the per-tree leaf tint is applied at draw time), `marginM` metres added to the bounding sphere's radius so no texel at the frame's edge is cut, `mips` whether the atlas is drawn with a mip chain (each view's square halved alone, a texel covered when half its base texels are; off until the owner approves the look). The leaves' lighting normals lean out of the crown by shared/look/leaves.json `canopyBlend`, as the near trees'. Read at load and validated (a bad entry fails naming the field); no generated file.

leafShade.$comment: How a leaf texel is lit at draw time (BUGS.md #106: the impostor crowns drew lighter than the near crowns, the colour of the grass behind them): ambient the hemisphere light's share (the near leaves take their baked sky light and corner occlusion, which a texel has none of; 1 open sky), albedo a scale on the palette colour (the near leaves' painted tile is darker than its palette base). Fitted on a GPU against ?impostors=0 at 80 and 150 m.

ao.$comment: Ambient occlusion baked into each texel (WORK_QUEUE item 31: the impostors read paler than the near crowns at the hand-over): a texel darkens by strength × the share of the tree's cells within radiusM m of its hit, as the near leaves' corner occlusion and sky light darken a crown's inside. strength 0 is off: opt-in until the owner approves the look (try 0.5).

far.$comment: Where impostors take over from the full-detail trees, per Far trees setting tier (Settings → Graphics → Far trees; the presets pick the tier by name): `draw` `impostor` (one baked quad a tree, the view nearest the camera dithered with the next) or `none` (no far trees). A tree is either its real leaves or its impostor, never a steady blend by distance (BUGS.md #154, owner 2026-11-13: 'it shouldn't ever be partial transitions over distance, but over time'): it turns into its impostor once farther than `outM` (m, the eye to its crown's centre) and back into the real tree once nearer than `inM` (the gap keeps a tree at the boundary from flickering), each switch cross-fading over `fadeS` seconds (each pixel showing one of the two by the screen dither); `toM` where far trees stop (0: never).
